options.name: Aquatic Form
options.benefit: Gain swim 30 feet, aquatic tremorsense 30 feet, and the aquatic subtype; land speed becomes 10 feet.

options.name: Enlarged Body
options.benefit: Increase size as enlarge person by up to two categories, maximum Huge.

options.name: Multiple Eyes
options.benefit: Cannot be flanked and gain +4 Perception.

options.name: Toppling Fists
options.benefit: Attempt a bull rush against a creature within 10 feet as a standard action.

options.name: Wings
options.benefit: Gain fly speed 60 feet with average maneuverability.
